merchant_channels_disconnected_timestamp.name: merchant_channels_disconnected_timestamp_check
merchant_channels_disconnected_timestamp.value: "merchant_channels"."disconnected_at" IS NULL OR "merchant_channels"."connected_at" IS NULL OR "merchant_channels"."disconnected_at" >= "merchant_channels"."connected_at"

messages_status_timestamp_check.name: messages_status_timestamp_check
messages_status_timestamp_check.value: "messages"."status" <> 'failed' OR ("messages"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL)

subscriptions_counters_check.name: subscriptions_counters_check
subscriptions_counters_check.value: "subscriptions"."price_iqd" >= 0 AND "subscriptions"."base_reply_limit" >= 0 AND "subscriptions"."base_replies_used" >= 0 AND "subscriptions"."base_replies_remaining" >= 0 AND "subscriptions"."addon_replies_remaining" >= 0 AND "subscriptions"."emergency_credit_amount" >= 0 AND "subscriptions"."emergency_debt" >= 0

manual_reply_requests_failure_code_check.name: manual_reply_requests_failure_code_check
manual_reply_requests_failure_code_check.value: "manual_reply_requests"."status" not in ('failed', 'uncertain') or "manual_reply_requests"."error_code" is not null

orders_payment_metadata_check.name: orders_payment_metadata_check
orders_payment_metadata_check.value: ("orders"."payment_status" = 'paid' AND "orders"."payment_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."payment_verified_by_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."payment_rejection_reason" IS NULL) OR ("orders"."payment_status" = 'failed' AND "orders"."payment_verified_at" IS NULL AND "orders"."payment_verified_by_account_id" IS NULL AND "orders"."payment_rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("orders"."payment_status" NOT IN ('paid', 'failed') AND "orders"."payment_verified_at" IS NULL AND "orders"."payment_verified_by_account_id" IS NULL AND "orders"."payment_rejection_reason" IS NULL)

migration_runs_valid_time_range.name: migration_runs_valid_time_range
migration_runs_valid_time_range.value: "migration_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL OR "migration_runs"."started_at" IS NULL OR "migration_runs"."finished_at" >= "migration_runs"."started_at"

background_jobs_processing_has_lock.name: background_jobs_processing_has_lock
background_jobs_processing_has_lock.value: ("background_jobs"."status" <> 'processing') OR ("background_jobs"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "background_jobs"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL)

background_jobs_nonprocessing_has_no_loc.name: background_jobs_nonprocessing_has_no_lock
background_jobs_nonprocessing_has_no_loc.value: ("background_jobs"."status" = 'processing') OR ("background_jobs"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "background_jobs"."locked_by" IS NULL)
